reference: FFmpeg 9.0.2 native decoders (exact build pinned separately in the decode reference receipt); MPEG audio Layer I and II against its float decoders mp1float and mp2float, whose fixed-point defaults output 16-bit samples; development-only oracle on macOS is Homebrew FFmpeg 9.0.2 and is never qualification evidence

audio_decode.float_tolerance_basis: ISO/IEC 14496-4 / 13818-4 'full accuracy' 16-bit decoder criterion applied to candidate-minus-reference planar float output, full scale = 1.0
audio_decode.rms_formula: sqrt(mean((candidate - reference)^2)) over every sample of the channel in the stream; 2^-15/sqrt(12) = 8.809e-06
audio_decode.no_exclusions: every decoded sample of every channel is compared; no normalization, delay search or gain fitting

lossless_audio_decode.tolerance: none: bit-exact (RFC 9639 decoding is integer-exact; the float output is the integer sample scaled by a power of two as FFmpeg converts it)

audio_device_path.contract: ffmpeg -f <demuxer> -i pipe:0 -vn -ac 2 -f pulse|alsa: decoder output -> swresample default stereo rematrix -> pcm_s16le interleaved at the decoder sample rate
audio_device_path.basis: float criterion above propagated through round-to-nearest s16 conversion can flip at most one rounding step

exact: every output picture's complete Y/Cb/Cr samples at native bit depth
video_decode.tolerance: none: bit-exact (ITU-T H.264/H.265 decoding processes are integer-exact)

video_output_path.tolerance: none pre-approved: bit-exact RGBA required; any deviation is recorded as a failure pending a reviewed disposition
